astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: Possible Supernova Remnant in Galactic Center
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: Do you see that blue blob to the lower right of the image center?   Astronomers think that it shows where a massive star exploded as a supernova whose light reached Earth 1,700 years ago.
